title: This project builds the portable claude-settings backlog as PRs
why: Your idea, Oct 26: the goal of the advisor setup was something that answers your questions and pushes the backlog along; this cloud project can edit code.
note: Checked Oct 26 at claude-settings 149f4bc5: CI (gates.yml) runs on ubuntu, macos and windows, so a cloud PR is proven on all three. Cloud threads each run in their own container: parallel lanes cost your machines nothing (no worktrees, brake or idle-CPU problems). Limits: claude-settings hooks are not installed in the cloud session, so guards do not run there (a fresh reviewer and CI gate each logic diff); machine-bound steps (live transcript replays, Mac kill guard, desktop app behaviour, install checks) stay local; merges need your word or a grant. Blocked by the project instruction 'Never push to claude-settings'. Decision card sent Oct 26: cloud builds and you merge (advisor pick), cloud builds with a merge grant, or briefs only. Candidates: c46, c50, c51. Oct 26: you asked for a full plan first; decision cards withdrawn. Plan doc: https://claude.ai/artifact/U4jM83VeaTVmePCDig78fD (pilot c46 lane 2, then c50, c51, c45 as one batch; you merge with merge/merge.py; five decisions with picks). Your rulings, Oct 26: (1) delete the project instruction against pushing; start with the pilot only. (2) This project holds the standing merge grant. (3) Retire the terminal advisor once this runs. (4) Add all repos for reference; act only on claude-settings; any step for another repo gets a quick check-in with you first. (5) The advisor thread answers build threads' questions. Finding, Oct 26 (build advisor, corrected): gh REST calls work through the cloud proxy with admin rights, but GraphQL is refused, and merge.py's gh pr view/list/checks/merge use GraphQL, so merge.py cannot run in the cloud yet (fix filed as c53, the merge tool works from a cloud session). A button merge would leave docs/records.md stale. The pilot stops at a green PR. Oct 26: you are moving this project to another account. Port kit: plans/port-project-instructions.md and plans/port-starter-brief.md (also in project files under port/). Advice: move before the pilot's build thread starts, or after it ends. Your ruling, Oct 26: the coordinator orchestrates; advisor threads are swapped for fresh ones with a handoff when they get long; several advisors run in parallel, one per area. Advisor proposal, Oct 26 (not yet ruled): areas = build (c52 batches, guards, merge tool, CI), Organize phase (rules, docs, glossary, layout), local liaison (goal runs, Mac, machine-bound briefs), roll-out repos (opens only after a check-in with you). Start with build and local liaison; add the others when work is queued. Each advisor edits only its own steps; shared meta (cull numbers, phases) by whoever measures, pull before write. Hand-off: at about 40 exchanges (a heavy turn counts as several), at a phase change, or at once on a slip (misses a ruling, re-asks something answered, contradicts the roadmap). The note lives in handoffs/<area>-<date>.md in this repo: area and steps owned; open rulings with their homes; threads and PRs in flight with branch, head and CI verdict; open questions and who waits on them; next action; premises with sources and the commits checked. Build order after the pilot (build advisor, Oct 26): c53 merge tool from the cloud first, then batch 1 = c50, c51, c45, plus c44's cloud part and c46 lane 1 now that goal 3 has closed. Open PRs, Oct 26: #577 pilot (c46 lane 2), #578 (c51). Both stop at green until c53 or a local merge.py run. File overlaps, checked Oct 26 (build advisor): #577 and c53 both edit merge/merge.py and merge/test_merge.py; #578 and c45 both edit hooks/reply_judge.py and output-styles/shiv-stylisms.md. So c53 builds on #577's branch (claude/project-thread-ua5nok) and c45 on #578's (claude/project-thread-v407gb), each rebased onto main once that PR merges. c53 and c45 share no files, so they run in parallel.
